Norway's King Harald V Laid to Rest in Funeral Service

Norway held a state funeral for King Harald V, who passed away at the age of 87. The funeral took place in Oslo, with his casket carried through the streets as crowds paid their respects. Prince William represented the British Royal Family, attending alongside other European royals and world leaders. The service marked a final farewell to the monarch, often referred to as the 'grandfather' of the nation.
